text: yes. now, there is the compiled game to think about as the main confirmation it carrys end to end.  and also @../../GUIDING_LIGHT.md will help guide you for the lab correctly so there is the correct work now and less reworking later. hows that sound
resolution: Addressed as part of req_0894. The compiled (no-V8) game is the end-to-end confirmation: STATS_TUNING bakes into a fixed STATS_CONFIG lump (MAP_LUMP 22, u32 version | f32[43]) via compile/playerStats.ts, mirroring PHYSICS_CONFIG; the Zig loader decodes it (framework/world/constructor.zig decodeStatsConfig) and world_loader.zig logs it ('[loader] player stats config: ... carries end to end'), proving the data reaches the compiled game. Designed per GUIDING_LIGHT.md: declarative data, factored into sums (money/capacity/skills are factor sums, not baked products), content-referenced outfit, no code in the loop. Per the user's ruling the HUD is React in dev/test only — the compiled game stays React-free and the native compiled HUD is a deliberate later effort, not a JS slopfest.
